description: This file declares functions for handling Forward Lock files, including attaching, reading, seeking, detaching, closing, and integrity checks, as well as retrieving content type.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_attach
methods.description: Attaches to an open Forward Lock file, assuming the file position is at the beginning.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from an open Forward Lock file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_lseek
methods.description: Updates the file position within an open Forward Lock file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_detach
methods.description: Detaches from an open Forward Lock file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_close
methods.description: Closes an open Forward Lock file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_CheckDataIntegrity
methods.description: Checks the data integrity of an open Forward Lock file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_CheckHeaderIntegrity
methods.description: Checks the header integrity of an open Forward Lock file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_CheckIntegrity
methods.description: Checks both data and header integrity of an open Forward Lock file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_GetContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of an open Forward Lock file.
